def priority(f):
    d = f['distance']
    rd = f['return_distance']
    pr = f['progress']
    rg = f['regret']
    return -d - 0.25*rd*pr + 0.15*rg
reference.intent: Fix return-aware sign and gate by progress to bias the late tour back toward start; add small regret lookahead to break equidistant ties.
reference.name: return_aware_progress
